book.name: Heꞌitaꞌita
book.title: HEꞌITAꞌITA Yoni ꞌina heꞌitaꞌita Yesu ꞌoinega

content: Galewa hauhauna ma baleꞌu hauhauna
Coinega galewa ma baleꞌu hauhaudi yaꞌitediya silatuwa, ta geya hola, ma hesi galewa nugenugetaina ma baleꞌu nugenugetaina siꞌwaiha.
Ma ꞌasa ꞌasiꞌasilalana yaꞌiteya tauna Yelusalema hauhauna galewega ꞌisulusuluma Yehoba ꞌoinega, ꞌihepaseya gide tohai mewahinena ꞌipasa ma mwanena baꞌidana sihelobaloba.

Ma wagahata wasawasa ꞌoinega ꞌenana madouna yahesagoheya, ꞌigwaeya, “Cuꞌita, Yehoba maꞌina tomotaiyao baꞌidanao ꞌabwa simiyamiya, weyahina tauna baꞌidadiu, ma taudi ꞌina tomota. Moisa Yehoba tauna baꞌidadiu,
Yehobaina mataneudi ꞌiloꞌiꞌilidi, weyahina geyaꞌabwa wete ꞌamasa, nuwana muyamuya, bo dou ꞌoidiya ꞌilatulatu. Weyahina tupwa miyamiyana ꞌigumwala pwaiya.”
Eeta wagahata wasawasa ꞌana tomiyaina ꞌigwaeya, “Ginaula mabwaiyana yagiheꞌehaudi,” ma wete ꞌigwaeya, “Gwae bewa ꞌuleledi, weyahina gwae moisa ma dumwaluna.”
Ta wete ꞌihegwaegauwa, ꞌigwaeya, “Cigumwala pwaiya. Taugu tuwa ꞌebe hegaina ma ꞌebe losaloha, ma ꞌeguma taiyewedi taudi taniꞌodi ꞌiyahala, nata weꞌaha bidalega yaꞌebwae tuwa, yawasidi weyahina.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌihewaiwai Seitani ꞌoinega, nata yaliyaya yatagwala ꞌoina ma ꞌiꞌahwa tamanegau, ma tauna yaꞌahwa natune.

Ma hesi taudi ꞌateweꞌaweꞌadi, ma taudi geya sihemisa, ma tohemata ganawalao, ma toloheꞌamasao, ma tologwaliyao, ma Tomudulele maꞌiyanao, ma dimwa ꞌadi tohemisao, ma toꞌeꞌaboꞌabowao, taudi bewa ꞌidi tupwa ꞌasa ꞌalaꞌalataina, beno ꞌamasa heluwena.”
Yelusalema hauhauna
Coinega aneloseyedi sebeni, mwalo muya biyodi sebeni ꞌadi toꞌahalao, ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega ꞌinaoma, ma ꞌihegwaegauwa, ꞌigwaeya, “Cunaoma ma Lami mwanena yaheꞌitago.”
Ta Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌitoegauwa ꞌoya saliyana tabwanina, ma ꞌasa ꞌausalana ꞌiheꞌitegauwa, sanina Yelusalema, galewega ꞌisulusuluma Yehoba ꞌoinega.
Ma Yehoba ꞌina wasawasa ꞌasilalana ꞌasaina ꞌoina ꞌisaesaehane, ta ꞌasaina ꞌiꞌasilala, gide tuwa dimwa wasawasa, ta ꞌinamanamala gide gelasi.

Ma ꞌasaina ꞌana ꞌali madouna ma saliyana, ma ꞌana ꞌahwaꞌeda ꞌadi baibaiwa tuwelo, ta ꞌahwaꞌedaedi ꞌadi toꞌitayahinao anelose tuwelo, ta wete ꞌahwaꞌedaedi ꞌoidiya susu tuwelowedi Isileli ꞌoinega sanidiyao silelediya.
Caliina ꞌana tupwaedi ꞌehata. Caigeda tupwa bolimana ꞌoinega, ꞌana ꞌahwaꞌedao ꞌetoi, tupwa bomatu ꞌoinega ꞌahwaꞌeda ꞌetoi, tupwa yalasiyega ꞌahwaꞌeda ꞌetoi, ma tupwa bwauli ꞌoinega ꞌahwaꞌeda ꞌetoi.
Casaina madouna siꞌabiya wahuwahu ꞌaigeda bwebweꞌana ꞌoina, beno dimwa tuwelo paꞌalidi tabwadiya, ma dimwaedi ꞌoidiya Lami ꞌana tohepwaila tuwelowedi sanidiyao silelediya.
Ma aneloseina baꞌidagu ꞌagwaegwae, nimana ꞌebelihe goula, ta ꞌabehega ꞌoinega ꞌasaina namanamalina ma ꞌana ꞌahwaꞌedao ma ꞌana ꞌali wete ꞌilihedi.

Casaina ꞌana saliya ta ꞌana tabataba tupwa ꞌehataedi mahemahetena. Eeta aneloseina ꞌina ꞌebelihe ꞌoinega ꞌasaina ꞌiliheya, ta ꞌana saliya ma ꞌana tabataba ma ꞌana hane mabwaiyana mahemahetena, gide tu tausani powa handeledi (2400) kilomita.
Ma ꞌali ꞌana bado nimanega ꞌiliheya, ta ꞌilobeya teti sikisi (36) lihe, beno handeledi poti powa (144) kiubiti. Aneloseina nimana gide loheya nimana ꞌana saliya gide.
Casaina ꞌana ꞌali dimwa wasawasa ma namanamalidi ꞌoidiyega siꞌabiya, ta ꞌasa ꞌalona goula ꞌoinega siꞌabiya, ta ꞌinamanamala gide tuwa gelasi.
Casaina ꞌana wahuwahu dimwanao, dimwa wasawasao ma namanamalidi ꞌoidiyega sihepaseya.

Wahuwahu ꞌaigeda ꞌana pasa dimwa wasawasa waꞌewaꞌeꞌena, heluwena ꞌana pasa dimwa ꞌana ꞌita niꞌu dubadubana gide, hetoina hebwehebwelina, ꞌehatana ꞌalaꞌalawana, henimana hebwehebwelina, waꞌewaꞌeꞌena ma dubadubana, hesikisina bwehabwehalina, hesebenina yogeyogena, ma heꞌeitina ꞌalaꞌalawana, henaenina wete yogeyogena, nima luwaluwaina ꞌalaꞌalawana, helebenina wete niꞌu dubadubana gide, ma hetuwelona dubadubana, nabuꞌa gide.

Ta ꞌasaina ꞌana ꞌahwaꞌedao tuwelowedi giniuba tuwelo madoudi tuwelo ꞌoidiyega sipaihowediya, ma ꞌahwaꞌeda ꞌaigeda giniuba ꞌaigeda ꞌoinega sipaihoweya. Ta ꞌasaina ꞌana ꞌeda mabwaiyana goula daisinamo, ꞌinamanamala gide gelasi.
Casaina ꞌoina geya Hada Heꞌasisi yaꞌita, weyahina Bada Yehoba Tohewaiwai hedada ma Lami, taudi tuwa Hada Heꞌasisiyedi.
Sinala ma waiꞌena geya sida saehaneya ꞌasaina ꞌoina, weyahina Yehoba ꞌina wasawasega ꞌiꞌatuhe ꞌasilaleya mabwaiyana, ma wete Lami ꞌihemayaleya ꞌasaina ꞌoina.
Ta ꞌasilalaina ꞌoinega mebaleꞌu ꞌabwa siyawala dadana, ma baleꞌu ꞌana kiniyao ꞌadi hepwatu siꞌeweyama ꞌasaina ꞌoina.
Ta ꞌasaina ꞌana ꞌahwaꞌedao sabwelowa geya sida gududiya, ma wete geya guguyou, ma geya nihuwana.
Ma ꞌebeloinao mabwaiyana ꞌidi heꞌasisi ma ꞌidi hepwatu siꞌewedima ꞌasaina ꞌalona.
Ta geyaꞌabwa ginaula biꞌibiꞌidi ꞌasaina ꞌoina siluhuluhu, nuwana topaihowa galadi bo toꞌeꞌaboꞌabowao. Beno tuwa taudi sanidi silele pwaiya Lamiina ꞌina bukiya, beno yawasida bukina ꞌoina.
